description: Welcome to this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in the desirable Cambridge Estates, where spacious interiors, abundant natural light, and thoughtful details come together to create an inviting and comfortable living experience. Step into the two-story foyer and into the large, open living room, which makes an immediate impression with huge windows and a stunning arched window that fills the space with natural light. The expansive family room is equally impressive, featuring a cozy gas fireplace flanked by floor-to-ceiling windows, plus additional skylights that bring even more sunlight into the heart of the home. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat, complete with a beautiful sitting area surrounded by bay windows, a spacious walk-in closet, and a spa-like en-suite bathroom with skylights that create a bright, serene atmosphere. The additional bedrooms are generously sized, feature ceiling fans and vaulted ceilings, and offer large walk-in closets for exceptional storage. Step outside to enjoy the beautifully spacious backyard and patio, fully fenced, providing plenty of room for relaxing, entertaining, dining al fresco, or enjoying the outdoors. Additional important highlights include a brand-new water heater (2026) and a newer roof (2022), offering valuable peace of mind. With its generous living spaces, remarkable natural light, spacious bedrooms, abundant storage, and inviting outdoor areas, this Cambridge Estates home is ideally located with easy access to Interstate 295 and Routes 73 & 38, providing a convenient commute to Philadelphia while placing the beautiful Jersey Shore just about an hour away.
